content.title: City of Atlanta Government
content.text: In this city, we don’t look at diversity as something to tolerate we see it as a strength to celebrate.As we recognize Eid al-Fitr, marking the end of Ramadan, we honor a time of reflection, generosity, and community. The Quran encourages us to “do what is beautiful,” and here in Atlanta, that means continuing to be a city that welcomes all cultures and faiths. #FlashbackFriday #EidMubarak #MovingAtlantaForwardAll reactions:Sara HamdounFor those saying “Jesus is Lord,” please remember to respect other people’s beliefs.Muslims also believe in Jesus. Take a moment to educate yourself and be mindful of those around you.
